####
# WSTS toolkit example project: LinuxDemo
#
# An ordinary F Prime project that knows nothing about simulation. Its simulated
# deployment is generated by `fprime-wsts generate` (see the repository README).
####
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.26)
project(LinuxDemoProject VERSION 1.0.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

find_package(FPrime REQUIRED PATHS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../lib/fprime/cmake")

add_fprime_subdirectory("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Components")
add_fprime_subdirectory("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/LinuxDemo")
